quote: Eye sizes and interdistances: ALE 0.52, AME 0.44, PLE 0.37, PME 0.37; ALE–AME 0.17, AME–AME 0.24, PLE–PME 0.02, PME–PME 0.90.
note: New trait key eye_diameter_mm as already used on main (e.g. desk-d280, desk-d432). eye_diameter_mm because the Materials and methods print a maximum-diameter definition of eye size (confirmed by audit 826 reading the whole Methods). Anatomy only; no visual function is claimed. Value is the figure printed against its own eye label (PME); the other eyes and the interdistances are not in this record. Lines follow the order the sentence prints the eyes (ALE, AME, PLE, PME). Sex: male. Licence: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' (publisher XML, read in three pieces and joined); Copyright: Yejie Lin, Xunyou Yan, Shuqiang Li. Publisher's own free full text, accepted. DOI as printed on the publisher page. Crossref was not read. method: measurement of the preserved type specimen as listed in the Description sentence 'Eye sizes and interdistances'; the whole Materials and methods section (read by audit 827 in the publisher XML: nine sentences, then the abbreviations list) defines eye size as a maximum diameter: 'Eye sizes were measured as the maximum diameter in either a dorsal or frontal view.' and gives 'All measurements are in millimetres.'
conditions: Male of Chilobrachys jinchengi Lin & Li, sp. nov. Measured specimen: the male holotype IZCAS-Ar42677, named in the Description lead-in 'Male (holotype, IZCAS-Ar42677) (Figs 5B–H, 6, 7).', followed by 'Carapace 13.12 long, 10.21 wide, brown with long setae.'. Type material as printed (publisher XML, read in two pieces and rejoined with no change): 'Holotype ♂ (IZCAS-Ar42677), China: Tibet: Nyingchi, Medog, from Baibung to Muge, 29.2386°N, 95.1831°E, elevation 1310 m, 21.VIII.2018, Jincheng Liu leg. Paratype 1♂ (IZCAS-Ar42678), same data as holotype.' The paratype is not measured separately. The female is printed 'Female. unknown.' Printed heading path (publisher XML and article_preview page): 'Taxonomy' > 'Family Theraphosidae Thorell, 1869' > 'Subfamily Selenocosmiinae Simon, 1889' > 'Genus Chilobrachys Karsh, 1892' (sic; 'Karsch' in the Type species line) > 'Chilobrachys jinchengi Lin & Li, sp. nov.' > 'Description'; no Class or Order heading is printed. Materials and methods, read whole (publisher XML): 75% ethanol, deposited in IZCAS; spermathecae cleared in trypsin; LEICA M205C stereomicroscope; Olympus C7070 camera; Helicon Focus 6.7.1 and Adobe Photoshop CC 2018; terminology after Bertani (2000); 'All measurements are in millimetres.'; 'Eye sizes were measured as the maximum diameter in either a dorsal or frontal view.'; leg-measurement format; abbreviations. Sentence before the eye sentence: 'MOA 0.77 long, anterior width 0.89, posterior width 1.38.'; after it: 'Fovea slightly procurved.' The eye sentence was returned in two consecutive pieces (the first ending 'PME 0.38;'), rejoined with one space; the same text was returned by the XML and the article_preview page. It prints the eyes in the order ALE, AME, PLE, PME; the four interdistances are in the same sentence but not in these records.
